title: What's New in Manufacturing: Integration to Warehouse (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Demo: Posting Production and Putaway Workflow

features.name: Warehouse Putaway for Production Output
features.description: Starting with this release you can use warehouse putaway for production output means you can use the same warehouse processes as in other receipts. It is especially important for locations where directed putaway and pick is enabled.
caveats: For directed putaway and pick locations only two options are available: no warehouse handling and warehouse putaway
For other locations inventory putaway is also an option

features.name: Automatic Putaway Document Generation
features.description: When posting production order quantities, putaway documents are generated automatically. This behavior is controlled by the used putaway worksheet toggle in the location card page.
caveats: Behavior is controlled by putaway worksheet toggle setting

features.name: Putaway Creation from Worksheet and Finished Orders
features.description: You can create putaway for production order from the putaway worksheet for partial quantities, and can trigger creation of warehouse putaway for remaining quantity from finished production order.

features.name: Pick Plus Manual Flushing Method
features.description: A new flushing method pick plus manual replaces the old manual method. The manual flushing method remains but now behaves differently and does not require picking anymore. This provides additional flexibility for manual operations.
caveats: Capability must be activated in feature management
Consistent with existing backward and forward flushing methods

features.name: Allow Warehouse Over-Pick
features.description: New field allow warehouse over pick is visible in the item card. This enables picking more raw materials than originally requested for production order and deciding what to do with extra stock.
caveats: When disabled, exact quantities are required

features.name: Return Over-picked Items to Warehouse
features.description: New movement worksheet page action return over pick quantity enables returning over-picked items back to warehouse for items that were picked in excess of requirements.
